command: gh api repos/gmboquet/mixle/actions/runs/35169724301 --jq '"run \(.id): \(.name) event=\(.event) head_sha=\(.head_sha) \(.status)/\(.conclusion)"'; gh api repos/gmboquet/mixle/actions/runs/35169724301/jobs --jq '.jobs[] | "JOB: \(.name) :: \(.conclusion) (id \(.id))", (.steps[] | select(.name|test("audit|SBOM|bandit|security analysis|gitleaks";"i")) | "   \(.name) :: \(.conclusion)")'; J=$(gh api repos/gmboquet/mixle/actions/runs/35169724301/jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="gitleaks (full history)") | .id'); gh run view --repo gmboquet/mixle --job $J --log | grep -oE 'event type: [a-z_]+|[0-9]+ commits scanned|no leaks found' | sort -u; echo -n 'waivers declared: '; python3 -c "import json; print(len(json.load(open('.github/pip-audit-waivers.json'))['waivers']))"
